headline: Grumpy Walrus sold 200M BANK (~20% of its bag, ~484 ADA) and ~1.1k FLOW (~418 ADA, ~313k left, well under the 100k sell line) at 7:48 PM, then bought ~798k MEPE (~554 ADA), ~0.94M CITY (~10.9M held), ~15.5k COCK and ~574 NIGHT; net ADA ~+126; ASCEND untouched. PUP hit launch+24h with no DEX pool, so it failed the SW-01 gate. Seven new swarm launches (BREAK, CAPY, CHANCOIN, MAGE, PEAK, PRT, TCM; coordinated buyers, no DEX pool): Pass. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: seven swarm launches landed in one two-minute window sharing the same two repeat early buyers, so one crew is now running several launches at once rather than one a day.
